title: Beckman Coulter Optima LE-80K Ultracentrifuges
desc: Optima LE-80K Ultracentrifuges perform common calculations such as CsCl speed reductions, run conversions, and more. ESP Efficient Sedimentation Program simulates separations to optimize run times. The imbalance-tolerant drive allows visual balancing of rotor loads and eliminates the need for operators to weigh individual samples. Features: Reliabi
